clips.label: The Storm Engine · 1 minute
clips.note: A red ribbon leads into a copper wind machine, through a storm and out above a white salt desert.
clips.details:
A new theme with stronger sustained pans, zooms and a turning passage through the clouds. Ivory turbine blades become storm ridges; red silk becomes a kite above the salt plain. The final travelling pullback branches from the earlier single-kite painting. Fine details and the kite's cloth and spars redraw; recurring color and shape connect the scenes without establishing literal object identity.

Silent 60-second cut. Native 1536×1024 paintings, 24 fps. Recurrent Krea repaints retain previous-painting initialization, CFG 1, three Euler intervals and recorded independent seeds. All 180 selected paintings survive at three paintings per displayed second. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 fills the intervals outside recurrence; the final seven frames briefly hold the last painting to avoid a peripheral edge seam.
